verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א נִֽינְוֵ֑ה סֵ֧פֶר חֲז֛וֹן נַח֖וּם הָאֶלְקֹשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā nî·nə·wêh sê·p̄er ḥă·zō·wn na·ḥūm hā·’el·qō·šî
verses.literal: This is the burden against Nineveh the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה קַנּ֤וֹא וְנֹקֵם֙ אֵ֣ל יְהוָ֖ה נֹקֵ֥ם וּבַ֣עַל חֵמָ֑ה יְהוָה֙ נֹקֵ֤ם לְצָרָ֔יו ה֖וּא וְנוֹטֵ֥ר לְאֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh qan·nō·w wə·nō·qêm ’êl Yah·weh nō·qêm ū·ḇa·‘al ḥê·māh Yah·weh nō·qêm lə·ṣā·rāw hū wə·nō·w·ṭêr lə·’ō·yə·ḇāw
verses.literal: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God the LORD is avenging and full of wrath The LORD takes vengeance on His foes - and reserves [wrath] for His enemies

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֙יִם֙ וּגְדוֹל כֹּ֔חַ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֣א וְנַקֵּ֖ה יְנַקֶּ֑ה דַּרְכּ֔וֹ בְּסוּפָ֤ה וּבִשְׂעָרָה֙ וְעָנָ֖ן אֲבַ֥ק רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim ū·ḡə·ḏōl kō·aḥ Yah·weh lō wə·naq·qêh yə·naq·qeh dar·kōw bə·sū·p̄āh ū·ḇiś·‘ā·rāh wə·‘ā·nān ’ă·ḇaq raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished . . . His path is in the whirlwind and storm and clouds are the dust beneath His feet

verses.original: גּוֹעֵ֤ר בַּיָּם֙ וַֽיַּבְּשֵׁ֔הוּ וְכָל־ הַנְּהָר֖וֹת הֶֽחֱרִ֑יב בָּשָׁן֙ וְכַרְמֶ֔ל אֻמְלַ֤ל וּפֶ֥רַח לְבָנ֖וֹן אֻמְלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: gō·w·‘êr bay·yām way·yab·bə·šê·hū wə·ḵāl han·nə·hā·rō·wṯ he·ḥĕ·rîḇ bā·šān wə·ḵar·mel ’um·lal ū·p̄e·raḥ lə·ḇā·nō·wn ’um·lāl
verses.literal: He rebukes the sea and dries it up He makes all the rivers run dry Bashan and Carmel wither and the flower of Lebanon wilts

verses.original: הָרִים֙ רָעֲשׁ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְהַגְּבָע֖וֹת הִתְמֹגָ֑גוּ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וַתִּשָּׂ֤א מִפָּנָ֔יו וְתֵבֵ֖ל וְכָל־ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rîm rā·‘ă·šū mim·men·nū wə·hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ hiṯ·mō·ḡā·ḡū hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tiś·śā mip·pā·nāw wə·ṯê·ḇêl wə·ḵāl yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: The mountains quake before Him and the hills melt away the earth trembles at His presence the world and all its dwellers . . .

verses.original: מִ֣י לִפְנֵ֤י יַֽעֲמ֔וֹד זַעְמוֹ֙ וּמִ֥י יָק֖וּם בַּחֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ חֲמָתוֹ֙ נִתְּכָ֣ה כָאֵ֔שׁ וְהַצֻּרִ֖ים נִתְּצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mî lip̄·nê ya·‘ă·mō·wḏ za‘·mōw ū·mî yā·qūm ba·ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw ḥă·mā·ṯōw nit·tə·ḵāh ḵā·’êš wə·haṣ·ṣu·rîm nit·tə·ṣū mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Who can withstand . . . His indignation Who can endure His burning anger . . . His wrath is poured out like fire even rocks are shattered before Him

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה ט֣וֹב לְמָע֖וֹז בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה וְיֹדֵ֖עַ חֹ֥סֵי בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṭō·wḇ lə·mā·‘ō·wz bə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh wə·yō·ḏê·a‘ ḥō·sê ḇōw
verses.literal: The LORD is good a stronghold in the day of distress He cares for those who trust in Him

verses.original: עֹבֵ֔ר וּבְשֶׁ֣טֶף יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כָּלָ֖ה מְקוֹמָ֑הּ יְרַדֶּף־ וְאֹיְבָ֖יו חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ḇêr ū·ḇə·še·ṭep̄ ya·‘ă·śeh kā·lāh mə·qō·w·māh yə·rad·dep̄- wə·’ō·yə·ḇāw ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: But with an overwhelming flood He will make an end [of Nineveh] and pursue His enemies into darkness

verses.original: מַה־ תְּחַשְּׁבוּן֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה ה֣וּא עֹשֶׂ֑ה כָּלָ֖ה צָרָֽה׃ לֹֽא־ תָק֥וּם פַּעֲמַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: mah- tə·ḥaš·šə·ḇūn ’el- Yah·weh hū ‘ō·śeh kā·lāh ṣā·rāh lō- ṯā·qūm pa·‘ă·ma·yim
verses.literal: Whatever you plot against the LORD He will bring to an end Affliction will not rise up a second time

verses.original: כִּ֚י סְבֻכִ֔ים עַד־ סִירִ֣ים אֻ֨כְּל֔וּ וּכְסָבְאָ֖ם סְבוּאִ֑ים כְּקַ֥שׁ מָלֵֽא׃ יָבֵ֖שׁ
verses.transliteration: kî sə·ḇu·ḵîm ‘aḏ- sî·rîm ’uk·kə·lū ū·ḵə·sā·ḇə·’ām sə·ḇū·’îm kə·qaš mā·lê yā·ḇêš
verses.literal: For they will be entangled as with thorns and consumed like the drink of a drunkard like stubble that is fully dry

verses.original: מִמֵּ֣ךְ יָצָ֔א חֹשֵׁ֥ב רָעָ֑ה עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה יֹעֵ֖ץ בְּלִיָּֽעַל׃ס
verses.transliteration: mim·mêḵ yā·ṣā ḥō·šêḇ rā·‘āh ‘al- Yah·weh yō·‘êṣ bə·lî·yā·‘al
verses.literal: From you, [O Nineveh] comes forth a plotter of evil against the LORD a counselor of wickedness

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר אִם־ שְׁלֵמִים֙ וְכֵ֣ן רַבִּ֔ים וְכֵ֥ן נָגֹ֖זּוּ וְעָבָ֑ר וְעִ֨נִּתִ֔ךְ אֲעַנֵּ֖ךְ לֹ֥א עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’im- šə·lê·mîm wə·ḵên rab·bîm wə·ḵên nā·ḡōz·zū wə·‘ā·ḇār wə·‘in·ni·ṯiḵ ’ă·‘an·nêḵ lō ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Though they are allied . . . and numerous yet they will be cut down and pass away Though I have afflicted you, [O Judah] I will afflict you no longer

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֶשְׁבֹּ֥ר מֹטֵ֖הוּ מֵֽעָלָ֑יִךְ אֲנַתֵּֽק׃ וּמוֹסְרֹתַ֖יִךְ
verses.literal: For I will now break their yoke from your neck and tear away your shackles

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וְצִוָּ֤ה עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֹֽא־ יִזָּרַ֥ע מִשִּׁמְךָ֖ ע֑וֹד אַכְרִ֨ית פֶּ֧סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֛ה מִבֵּ֨ית אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אָשִׂ֥ים קִבְרֶ֖ךָ כִּ֥י קַלּֽוֹתָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh wə·ṣiw·wāh ‘ā·le·ḵā lō- yiz·zā·ra‘ miš·šim·ḵā ‘ō·wḏ ’aḵ·rîṯ pe·sel ū·mas·sê·ḵāh mib·bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ā·śîm qiḇ·re·ḵā kî qal·lō·w·ṯā
verses.literal: The LORD has issued a command concerning you, [O Nineveh] There will be no descendants to carry on your name . . . I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods I will prepare your grave for you are contemptible

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה עַל־ הֶהָרִ֜ים רַגְלֵ֤י מְבַשֵּׂר֙ מַשְׁמִ֣יעַ שָׁל֔וֹם חָגִּ֧י חַגַּ֖יִךְ יְהוּדָ֛ה שַׁלְּמִ֣י נְדָרָ֑יִךְ כִּי֩ בְּלִיַּ֖עַל לֹ֨א יוֹסִ֥יף ע֛וֹד לַעֲבוֹר בָּ֥ךְ כֻּלֹּ֥ה נִכְרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘al- he·hā·rîm raḡ·lê mə·ḇaś·śêr maš·mî·a‘ šā·lō·wm ḥāg·gî ḥag·ga·yiḵ yə·hū·ḏāh šal·lə·mî nə·ḏā·rā·yiḵ kî bə·lî·ya·‘al lō yō·w·sîp̄ ‘ō·wḏ la·ʿă·ḇōr bāḵ kul·lōh niḵ·rāṯ
verses.literal: Look to the mountains the feet of one who brings good news who proclaims peace Celebrate your feasts O Judah fulfill your vows For the wicked will never again . . . march through you they will be utterly cut off
